summary.text: Ty Hankerson represents the 28th District on the New York City Council, which includes South Jamaica, South Richmond Hill, Rochdale Village and South Ozone Park in Queens.
His Council biography says he was previously District Chief of Staff to Council Speaker Adrienne E. Adams.

paragraphs.text: Hankerson was born in South Ozone Park and raised across the district, according to his Council biography.
He began his career at the Southern Queens Park Association as Founding Director of its Sports and Dance Camp and Special Assistant to the Executive Director.
His community involvement began with the 106th Precinct Law Enforcement Explorers and included organizing the Code Black protest in Southeast Queens.
Before taking office he was Community Outreach Director and then District Chief of Staff in Speaker Adams's Council office.
